title: Difference Discipline
prompt:
**Problem.** Line 1: n q. Then q lines: l r v (add v on [l, r]).
Print the checksum: sum of final values mod 1e9+7.

**Constraints:** 1 ≤ n, q ≤ 200000; |v| ≤ 10.

The cancel point is r+1, not r.

tests.name: asymmetric ops
tests.hint: Final [5,8,3,3]: checksum 19; the r-cancel W gives [5,3,3,3] → 14.

tests.name: load: 200000 ops
tests.hint: O(n + q) difference array; the off-by-one W drifts the checksum.
